title: Mechanism and Individualized Management of Hypertension Associated With Bruton Tyrosine Kinase Inhibitors: TheSignaling Pathway.
snippet: Bruton's tyrosine kinase inhibitors (BTKIs) have become the first-line treatment for B-cell malignancies such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia, significantly improving patient outcomes.
